mapper.select: SELECT lectures.id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, courses.credits, courses.target_grade AS target_grade, departments.name AS department_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE day_of_week WHEN 'MON' THEN '월요일' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화요일' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수요일' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목요일' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금요일' ELSE day_of_week END, ' ', LPAD(start_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':00 ~ ', LPAD(end_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':50' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id) AS schedule, lectures.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.lecture_id = lectures.id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE') AS current_enrollment, semesters.academic_year, semesters.term FROM lectures JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN departments ON courses.department_id = departments.id JOIN users ON lectures.professor_id = users.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC

SELECT lectures.id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, courses.credits, courses.target_grade AS target_grade, departments.name AS department_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE day_of_week WHEN 'MON' THEN '월요일' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화요일' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수요일' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목요일' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금요일' ELSE day_of_week END, ' ', LPAD(start_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':00 ~ ', LPAD(end_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':50' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id) AS schedule, lectures.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.lecture_id = lectures.id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE') AS current_enrollment, semesters.academic_year, semesters.term
ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.id AS college_id, c.code AS college_code, c.name AS college_name, d.id AS dept_id, d.code AS dept_code, d.name AS dept_name FROM colleges c LEFT JOIN departments d ON c.id = d.college_id AND d.active = 1 WHERE c.active = 1 ORDER BY c.code ASC, d.code ASC
